pre_execution_amendment.reason: Independent pre-execution review required an explicit beta=0 contribution control and warned that an overly compressed feature sentinel could create a false negative. The amendment therefore reports beta=0, a compact 52-feature family, and an enriched 148-feature family that only adds the already-frozen v80 deployment-visible 100-vector.

target_validity_hardening.reason: Every supervised beta row is defined as a strict-passing finite-search endpoint. Therefore all 276 outer-fit target constructions, not only the 75 heldout capacity checks, must pass before any downstream predictor decision is interpretable.

positive_witness_execution_repair.observed_fit_only_failure: One split-correct outer-fit cell had two SLSQP status-8 terminals whose directly recomputed maximum normalized gate was about -0.1555 and whose normalized physical-budget excess was zero.
positive_witness_execution_repair.reason: A numerical optimizer success flag is not required to prove existence of a feasible strict-passing beta. v83.1 therefore accepts a positive witness only after direct box, physical-budget, original eight-metric, and gate recomputation. Incomplete starts still make a no-witness conclusion inconclusive; they can never support a negative capacity claim. Accuracy thresholds, folds, features, models, costs, and heldout roles are unchanged.

independent_p1_audit_repair.result_access_before_amendment: Only the fit-only optimizer status-8 failure described above was observed; no prediction seal, heldout capacity, or outer score existed.
independent_p1_audit_repair.reason: Independent audit found no P0 and four P1 issues. v83.1 now rejects any nonpassing outer-fit target before training, uses the frozen radial projection and exact beta-zero reproduction check, states feature-dependency rather than process-order evidence, and cross-binds the supplied v80 parent into the validated v82 ancestry.

attempts: The first attempt stopped on the inherited all-terminals-complete rule at a fit-only status-8 endpoint.
The diagnostic replay exposed the same fit-only endpoint and no additional result.
The first audit-repair attempt stopped at the first context because a beta-zero diagnostic keyword was wired to the feature builder rather than the context record.

scientific_question: Can four coefficients of the v82 spatial-mask correction be predicted from deployment-visible observations under a leakage-safe nested pipeline while preserving all eight matched-accuracy gates in every one of the 75 already-open Case3 cells?

nested_upstream_contract.outer_heldout_base: select upstream hyperparameters using outer-fit only, refit on all outer-fit rows, and predict outer-heldout rows
nested_upstream_contract.outer_fit_base: using the same outer-fit-selected hyperparameters, generate one inner-cross-fitted base prediction for every outer-fit row; each row is excluded from its own upstream fit
nested_upstream_contract.reason: A v80 OOF prediction for a v83 training row may have been fitted using labels from the current v83 heldout block. Reusing it would create cross-stage stacking leakage even though every v80 row is individually out of fold.

spatial_representation.base_correction: c0=U32 a0 where a0 is produced under the nested upstream contract
spatial_representation.raw_directions: c0 elementwise multiplied by the fixed normalized z, y, x, and centered radial masks
spatial_representation.whitening: the unchanged v82 interior-gradient plus epsilon supported-field metric whitening
spatial_representation.candidate: c0 + D beta followed by unchanged strict CGLS K1

deployment_feature_contract.formal_replay_note: The formal runner builds the complete exact shell once per cell before replaying many fold models, but the frozen feature builder accepts no post-forward state. This supports deployability at the pre-first-forward point, not a measured process-order claim.
deployment_feature_contract.allowed_state: after the q8 detector solve and first exact adjoint h=A^T z_q8

blocks_in_order.name: visible_log_norms
blocks_in_order.formula: log1p norms of y, z_q8, r_q8, and h

blocks_in_order.name: direction_metric_log_spectrum
blocks_in_order.formula: log of the four raw metric eigenvalues divided by their maximum

deployment_feature_contract.enriched_definition: the compact 52-vector concatenated with the existing v80 100-dimensional deployment-visible vector, omitting the compact duplicate of the four visible log norms
forbidden_inputs: v82 beta or any heldout beta target
Zero-K2 or Zero-K4 fields or residuals
candidate field, gradient, observation error, or gate
frame index, snapshot time, or temporal neighbors
A h, y-A h, or any state requiring the first online exact forward

fit_target_contract.target: the directly recomputed feasible strict-passing beta with the lowest maximum gate among all 13 proposed terminals around the split-correct a0; SciPy success is diagnostic rather than necessary for a positive existence witness
fit_target_contract.capacity_gate: every outer-fit training target and every heldout split-correct representation must retain a strict passing endpoint before predictor success can be claimed
fit_target_contract.positive_witness_rule: A terminal is eligible only when its projected beta is finite, inside [-1,1]^4, inside the unchanged physical budget, directly passes the original eight metric comparisons, and has directly recomputed maximum gate <=1e-10.
fit_target_contract.negative_scope: If no positive witness exists and any start is incomplete, the cell is inconclusive. Only a complete 13-start roster with no witness can support no passing endpoint found under the frozen search; that is still not a mathematical impossibility proof.

nested_beta_selection.inner_folds: original five-frame blocks intersected with current outer-fit, one-frame inner embargo, and a complete partition of outer-fit heldout rows
selection_criteria_in_order: maximize inner truth groups passing all eight gates in all three geometries

decision.beta_zero_all_75: The split-correct nested v80 base already passes all cells; spatial-beta contribution is not established.
decision.constant_all_75: A fold-local mean suffices; close more complex predictor families.
decision.linear_all_75: A preregistered linear observation-only coefficient predictor suffices; do not train a larger model.
decision.rbf_all_75: A preregistered nonlinear sentinel passes; record strict opened-development learnability headroom and freeze one previously unopened public reacting-flow condition as the next external gate; do not run resource claims yet.
decision.no_arm_all_75: Close the preregistered compact52/enriched148 spatial-mask predictor roster; do not rescue it with a larger neural network.
decision.capacity_below_75: Close the split-correct four-mask representation around the nested base if any required outer-fit target or any of the 75 heldout cells lacks a strict passing endpoint; do not interpret the downstream predictor score.
decision.inconclusive: Any parent, split, optimizer, finite-value, exact-call, seal, mutation, source, or independent-recomputation check fails.
